title: Execution Readiness Status
description: Experimental (`media_buy.execution_readiness`). Whether the account can satisfy one execution requirement of a product, and the product rollup. `unknown` means the seller could not check: never evidence the account lacks the resource, never a reason to treat the product as not runnable.

enumDescriptions.ready: One suitable resource (for a connection, it is connected). Does not waive binding: for `event_source` and `catalog` the buyer still binds `resolved.resource_id`.
enumDescriptions.setup_required: No suitable resource, or the connection is `missing`, `pending`, `expired`, or `revoked`. The buyer can fix it (`sync_event_sources`, `sync_catalogs`, `authorization_url`).
enumDescriptions.selection_required: Several suitable resources; the buyer chooses one from `candidates[]` and binds it.
enumDescriptions.input_required: The seller cannot discover a suitable resource; the buyer supplies one on the request, such as an inline catalog.
enumDescriptions.unknown: The seller could not read the account's resources. Distinct from `setup_required`; the product may be runnable. `unknown_reason` says what to do.
